digest.component_or_area: test suites - jira_datacenter transport and pagination
propositions: Five identified tests have assertions that cannot fail due to missing implementation details, vacuous logic, or incomplete verification of claimed contracts
test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport does not construct a transport carrying the credential and cannot verify PAT is excluded from repr
test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST walk inline instead of calling the shared predicate, making it unable to catch predicate regressions
_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() lacks a parameterization seam to accept synthetic source code and must be extended with an optional src argument
test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username only asserts hasattr instead of exercising the method and verifying its return value is a username string not a bool or accountId

test_every_mutating_transport_member_still_fails_on_the_first_429 uses total <= 1 which permits zero client calls, and uses blanket pytest.raises(Exception) instead of asserting BackendHTTPError with code == 429
